ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; left lobe exhibits approximately 60:40 white-to-black pixel ratio, while the right lobe exhibits approximately 20:80 white-to-black pixel ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a contiguous white base in the inferior region with high-density circular black mottling in the superior and medial regions. Right lobe contains a contiguous dark base with sparse, discrete circular white/grey blobs concentrated in the medial and superior quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-amplitude, non-uniform serrations; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the superior-lateral margins with pixel-amplitude variations of 10-25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curves originating from the central notch, maintaining an upward and outward trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive clusters of high-contrast, textured circular pixel groupings (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips and along the superior trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, near-parallel thin white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) located medially on the dark pigmentation of the left lobe, adjacent to the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters on the lateral distal tips; visible irregular chipping and notch-like tissue loss along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense leopard-like circular mottling pattern across the high-intensity regions of the left lobe.
